subject: maths
question:
The given bar graph shows the distribution of the total expenditure (in hundreds) of a school under various expense heads in the year 2009.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86ceda5dd65b6d0a9f2ddbae6ba18a0e419e0f8897f952e2b780538158042ace.png] 

The total amount of expenditure of the school is how many times of its expenditure on advertisement?
solution:
**Given:**

Bar graph shows expenditures (in hundreds) on:

Infrastructure = 45, Transport = 37.5, Taxes = 20, Salary = 27.5, Interest on loan = 32.5, Advertisement = 35

**Formula used:**

Total expenditure ÷ Advertisement expenditure

**Calculations:**

Total expenditure of the school = 45 + 37.5 + 20 + 27.5 + 32.5 + 35 = 197.5

Expenditure on Advertisement = 35

⇒ Ratio = 197.5 ÷ 35 = 1975/350 = 79/14

**∴ The expenditure of the schoo**l **is 79/14 times the advertisement expenditure. (Option 2)**
